value.rationale: The entire natural gap-run spectrum is a nontrivial structural refinement of the genus and Frobenius invariants for infinitely many minimally three-generated semigroups. Sharp arithmetic progression uniqueness for long blocks and mod-five transitions for short blocks give mathematically motivated information not obtained from just the largest gap or total gap count.
